text:
Priya: ok this is a very important team tradition question: who gets the "Most Likely to Offer a Hot Take" award? I asked an LLM for nominations and low-key it's hilarious. :trophy:

Priya: I fed it last quarter's emoji reactions and meeting transcripts and asked for 8 silly award categories + one-liners. here's what it spat out.

Priya: ```Prompt: "Given these convo snippets and emoji reactions, suggest 8 playful, non-offensive team awards with 1-line justification each (e.g., 'Most Likely to Bring Snacks' - 'Never shows up empty-handed'). Keep it light and inclusive."```

Marco: please share, I need material for the next all-hands slide deck :joy:

Priya: 1) The Hot Take Torch - "Always has an opinion, often before coffee."
2) Keyboard Picasso - "Writes commit messages that read like poetry."
3) Snack Whisperer - "The team's go-to for secret cookie stashes."
4) Meeting Time Traveler - "Shows up to 2 AM standups in spirit."
5) Keyboard-Ninja Debugger - "Finds the one missing semicolon in a haystack."
6) Slack Haiku Champion - "Sends the most therapeutic 3-line messages."
7) PR Zen Master - "Reviews with patience and dad jokes."
8) Experimental Taste Tester - "Will try the weirdest prompt experiments and live to tell the tale."

Jenna: DEAD. "Keyboard Picasso" is Marco. No contest. :clap:

Marco: take the trophy. I'll hang it above my monitor next to my rubber duck. :duck:

Carlos: who got "Meeting Time Traveler"? because Ping me at 11pm and I'll accept the nomination. :alarm_clock:

Mei: can we actually make a tiny ceremony? Also infra-bot, can you make a poll? @infra-bot

infra-bot: @Mei Sure. Creating poll: "Which silly award should Marco get?" Options: Keyboard Picasso, Hot Take Torch, PR Zen Master. Vote in-thread by replying with option emoji.

Priya: also new challenge: write a 10-word acceptance speech for the award you get. Mine: "I accept this for the leftovers that fueled my pull requests."

Jenna: Marco's speech: "I debug in sonnets, merge in my sleep. Thank you." :sparkles:

Marco: voting 449 Keyboard Picasso (I voted for myself, obviously)

Carlos: 449 Hot Take Torch (guilty as charged)

Mei: 449 PR Zen Master (I appreciate infrastructure calm)

Priya: infra-bot, tally?

infra-bot: Poll results: Keyboard Picasso 1, Hot Take Torch 1, PR Zen Master 1. It's a three-way tie. Suggesting tie-breaker: office bake-off or emoji duel.

Jenna: emoji duel. Loser bakes brownies. :raising_hands:

Carlos: deal. also can someone clip the prompt + list to the #standup-notes channel? Might be a good morale boost.

Priya: done. I'll stick them into the handbook's 'fun' section. Also, note for product: include "Award generator" in the next hackday.

Marco: if the LLM can pick awards, can it also write the trophy engravings? Asking for a friend.

Mei: yes but only if trophy engraving includes an inside joke about 'missing semicolons' :grin:

Carlos: BRB writing my 10-word acceptance speech: "For bugs slain and snacks shared, I humbly accept this honor."

Jenna: this thread is the emotional support I needed at 3 PM. thanks team.

Priya: same. mini ceremony Friday 4pm in the kitchen. BYOB (bring your own brownie)
